tools.name: list_consultations
tools.title: List EHC consultations
tools.description: List EHC needs-assessment consultations in the school workspace, with pupil ref, LA, status, receipt date, and days remaining against the 15-calendar-day (minimum) statutory window. All data is fictional prototype seed data.

status.description: Filter by status. 'Open' = not yet submitted.

tools.name: get_consultation
tools.title: Get consultation detail
tools.description: Return the full detail for a single consultation by id: documents, identified needs (with capability, domain, draft response, evidence), activity log, and deadline. Fictional prototype data.

tools.name: list_section_f_templates
tools.title: List Section F template snippets
tools.description: Reusable Section F provision-response snippets for 'can meet in part' and 'cannot meet' outcomes, organised by the four statutory areas of need. Snippets may contain {{pupil}}, {{year_group}}, {{LA}} tokens.

domain.description: Filter by area of need, or 'all'.

tools.name: list_evidence
tools.title: List evidence documents
tools.description: List the school's evidence library — provision maps, staffing records, policies, training certificates — available to attach to Section F responses. Fictional prototype data.

tools.name: get_school_profile
tools.title: Get school profile
tools.description: Return the school's identity, provision catalogue by area of need, cohort baseline counts, staffing/capacity, and response-style preference. This is the source of truth for what the school currently offers.
